description: Website Rendering. Run a managed browser session against a public URL and collect the HTML after client-side scripts finish. Prefer Crawler for static markup; escalate to WebUnlocker on approved hosts when challenges persist. Credit cost: 2 credits per call.

block_ads.description: Skip ad-network requests while the page renders. Default: false.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

query.description: Public URL to load inside BrowserSolver's headless browser. Include http:// or https://.

timeout.description: Hard ceiling, in seconds, for the render session. When reached, BrowserSolver returns whatever HTML is available. Default: 30.

wait_for.description: CSS or XPath selector that must appear in the DOM before HTML is returned. The managed browser waits until the node exists (or until timeout).

wait_in_seconds.description: Extra pause, in seconds, after the page load event before BrowserSolver returns HTML. Helpful when widgets animate or hydrate late. Default: 0.

name: website_rendering
title: Website Rendering
